question: Find the name and type of the card with the highest converted mana cost among all cards that have a 'rakdos' watermark, are legal in the 'vintage' format, and do not have multiple faces on the same card. Also, return the artist who illustrated this card and the total number of cards that artist has illustrated meeting these same criteria.

prediction.sql:
WITH FilteredCards AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_049 AS name,
        c.XCL_071 AS type,
        c.XCL_011 AS cmc,
        c.XCL_002 AS artist,
        c.XCL_001 AS id
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
    WHERE c.XCL_074 = 'rakdos'
      AND l.XCL_084 = 'vintage'
      AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
      AND c.XCL_037 = 'normal'
),
TopCard AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM FilteredCards
    ORDER BY cmc DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
ArtistCount AS (
    SELECT
        fc.artist,
        COUNT(fc.id) AS total_cards
    FROM FilteredCards fc
    GROUP BY fc.artist
)
SELECT
    tc.name,
    tc.type,
    tc.artist,
    ac.total_cards
FROM TopCard tc
INNER JOIN ArtistCount ac ON tc.artist = ac.artist

WITH FilteredCards AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_049 AS name,
        c.XCL_071 AS type,
        c.XCL_011 AS cmc,
        c.XCL_002 AS artist,
        c.XCL_001 AS id
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
    WHERE c.XCL_074 = 'rakdos'
      AND l.XCL_084 = 'vintage'
      AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
      AND c.XCL_037 = 'normal'
),
TopCard AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM FilteredCards
    ORDER BY cmc DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
ArtistCount AS (
    SELECT
        fc.artist,
        COUNT(fc.id) AS total_cards
    FROM FilteredCards fc
    GROUP BY fc.artist
)
SELECT
    tc.name,
    tc.type,
    tc.artist,
    ac.total_cards
FROM TopCard tc
INNER JOIN ArtistCount ac ON tc.artist = ac.artist
